items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Walter Gross and Mickey Bloom were standing there and they were telling Rudy Vallee, 'If you think we're going to go on after that band, you're crazy.'

ctx.x: So, we didn't mind, we just enjoyed the band, we really enjoyed it. Rented two houses, and we lived in the -- they guys lived in the houses, and finally Mildred came up, and we rented a house and we had a wonderful -- we had clambakes on the beach on our day's off and it was just a great time. So, 4th of July came around, and that was the big time for Rudy Vallee to make his appearance at Bar Harbor in the same ballroom. So, naturally we have to go on first. And, we barrelled, I mean that band really played. And we

finished and there wasn't too much applause, except as I walked off the stage, Walter Gross and Mickey Bloom were standing there and they were telling Rudy Vallee, 'If you think we're going to go on after that band, you're crazy.'
